trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.inShort: Earn the other 54 trophies and the Platinum pops on its own.

steps.text: Work through stages S1 to S6 in order so story, activities and grinds are all covered.
Use the Tracker counter on every targeted trophy so nothing sits one short at the end.
When the 54th trophy lands, this Platinum unlocks automatically with no extra action.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the Platinum pops on its own. Work through stages S1 to S6 in order so story, activities and grinds are all covered. Use the Tracker counter on every targeted trophy so nothing sits one short at the end. When the 54th trophy lands, this Platinum unlocks automatically with no extra action.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.inShort: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game.

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the first cutscene.
Follow the on-screen objectives until the mission complete banner appears.
The trophy unlocks as the mission ends; it cannot be skipped in a normal playthrough.

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. Start a new game and play the opening mission from the first cutscene. Follow the on-screen objectives until the mission complete banner appears. The trophy unlocks as the mission ends; it cannot be skipped in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 1 holds the balcony meditation tied to Positive Mental Attitude; finish that spot before the chapter closes.
trophies.inShort: Finish every Chapter 1 mission, and grab the Chapter 1 meditation spot before you do.

steps.text: Play through all Chapter 1 story missions in order from the mission list.
Before the final Chapter 1 mission, visit the balcony meditation spot so Positive Mental Attitude stays safe.
Complete the chapter finale and the trophy unlocks on the chapter complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 mission, and grab the Chapter 1 meditation spot before you do. Play through all Chapter 1 story missions in order from the mission list. Before the final Chapter 1 mission, visit the balcony meditation spot so Positive Mental Attitude stays safe. Complete the chapter finale and the trophy unlocks on the chapter complete screen.

a.text: Chapter 1 content stays reachable after the chapter ends, so nothing in this chapter can be missed.

b.text: The balcony meditation spot is only offered during Chapter 1, so one collectible can be lost here.

dispute.call: Treat Chapter 1 as a soft deadline: meditate on the balcony before finishing the chapter, then move on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.inShort: Finish every Chapter 2 mission.

steps.text: Continue the story into Chapter 2 and clear its missions in order.
Use free roam between missions to start activity types for Master of None while you travel.
Complete the Chapter 2 finale and the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 mission. Continue the story into Chapter 2 and clear its missions in order. Use free roam between missions to start activity types for Master of None while you travel. Complete the Chapter 2 finale and the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.inShort: Finish every Chapter 3 mission.

steps.text: Clear all Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Keep a partner activity and a race on your route between missions to chip at the activity trophies.
Finish the Chapter 3 finale and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 3 mission. Clear all Chapter 3 story missions in order. Keep a partner activity and a race on your route between missions to chip at the activity trophies. Finish the Chapter 3 finale and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.inShort: Finish every Chapter 4 mission.

steps.text: Clear all Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Stranger strands open up around this chapter, so start them as their markers appear.
Finish the Chapter 4 finale and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 4 mission. Clear all Chapter 4 story missions in order. Stranger strands open up around this chapter, so start them as their markers appear. Finish the Chapter 4 finale and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.inShort: Finish the final story mission for the Gold story capstone.

steps.text: Finish Chapters 1 to 4 so the final mission becomes available.
Stock up on armour, snacks and ammo before starting the finale.
Complete the final mission and watch the ending; the Gold unlocks as the credits approach.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission for the Gold story capstone. Finish Chapters 1 to 4 so the final mission becomes available. Stock up on armour, snacks and ammo before starting the finale. Complete the final mission and watch the ending; the Gold unlocks as the credits approach.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run.

steps.text: Pick up the Breakfast Run mission marker when it appears in the early story.
Complete each objective in order without skipping the mission.
The trophy unlocks on the mission passed screen.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Pick up the Breakfast Run mission marker when it appears in the early story. Complete each objective in order without skipping the mission. The trophy unlocks on the mission passed screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.text: Start The Cartel Heist from its story marker and complete the setup beats.
Play the heist through to the escape objective and lose any heat it raises.
The trophy unlocks when the heist is marked complete.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Start The Cartel Heist from its story marker and complete the setup beats. Play the heist through to the escape objective and lose any heat it raises. The trophy unlocks when the heist is marked complete.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission Child's Play.

steps.text: Start Child's Play from its story marker when it appears.
Follow the mission objectives through to the final scene.
The trophy unlocks on the mission passed screen.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Start Child's Play from its story marker when it appears. Follow the mission objectives through to the final scene. The trophy unlocks on the mission passed screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission Headliners.

steps.text: Start Headliners from its story marker in the later chapters.
Complete the mission objectives in order.
The trophy unlocks when Headliners is marked complete.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Start Headliners from its story marker in the later chapters. Complete the mission objectives in order. The trophy unlocks when Headliners is marked complete.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Set inside VCIA like Catch Me If You Can; clear that free-roam departure before or right after this mission while the airport is open to you.
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport.

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown from its story marker.
While you are at VCIA, note the departure areas used again by Catch Me If You Can.
Complete the takedown objectives and the trophy unlocks on mission completion.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Start VCIA Takedown from its story marker. While you are at VCIA, note the departure areas used again by Catch Me If You Can. Complete the takedown objectives and the trophy unlocks on mission completion.

a.text: VCIA stays fully explorable in free roam after the mission, so the airport departure trophy is never at risk.

b.text: Airport access tightens after the takedown, making an unscheduled departure harder to set up later.

dispute.call: Do Catch Me If You Can in the same session as this mission while VCIA is wide open.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.inShort: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.text: Start Operation Savage Glory from its late-story marker.
Bring armour and a strong loadout; this is one of the heavier combat missions.
Complete the operation and the trophy unlocks on mission completion.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Start Operation Savage Glory from its late-story marker. Bring armour and a strong loadout; this is one of the heavier combat missions. Complete the operation and the trophy unlocks on mission completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.inShort: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion counter.

steps.text: Open the completion checklist and work category by category: story, strangers, activities, collectibles, exploration.
Cross-check your percentage against a full 100 percent checklist so no small category is left behind.
Meditation spots, card sets and area discovery all feed the counter, so finish them before hunting the last percent.
At exactly 100 percent the Gold unlocks; the Tracker counter here mirrors the percentage.

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion counter. Open the completion checklist and work category by category: story, strangers, activities, collectibles, exploration. Cross-check your percentage against a full 100 percent checklist so no small category is left behind. Meditation spots, card sets and area discovery all feed the counter, so finish them before hunting the last percent. At exactly 100 percent the Gold unlocks; the Tracker counter here mirrors the percentage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.inShort: Land 250 stunts across Leonida.

steps.text: Use a fast car or bike and hit marked ramps and jumps; a stunt counts when the game registers the landing.
Chain stunt runs along the coast roads so travel time between jumps stays low.
Tick the counter after each session; at 250 registered stunts the Silver unlocks.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida. Use a fast car or bike and hit marked ramps and jumps; a stunt counts when the game registers the landing. Chain stunt runs along the coast roads so travel time between jumps stays low. Tick the counter after each session; at 250 registered stunts the Silver unlocks.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.inShort: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once.

steps.text: Open the activities list and note the 9 activity types the game tracks.
Start one session of each type; you only need to try it, not win it.
After the ninth different type is tried, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. Open the activities list and note the 9 activity types the game tracks. Start one session of each type; you only need to try it, not win it. After the ninth different type is tried, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.inShort: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Visit the Shooting Range and clear each challenge once to learn its target pattern.
Replay challenges with the weapon class they favour, prioritising accuracy streaks over speed.
When all 42 challenges show a gold medal, the Silver unlocks.

trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Shooting Range and clear each challenge once to learn its target pattern. Replay challenges with the weapon class they favour, prioritising accuracy streaks over speed. When all 42 challenges show a gold medal, the Silver unlocks.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.inShort: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.

steps.text: Find each Top Fun drone race start point and run the course once to learn the gates.
Replay until you place first at that location, then move to the next.
A win at the 14th location unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each Top Fun drone race start point and run the course once to learn the gates. Replay until you place first at that location, then move to the next. A win at the 14th location unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.inShort: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not stack.

steps.text: Enter races from the map markers and win one at each distinct race event.
Use a tuned vehicle for street races and save off-road events for a suitable vehicle.
Your 20th distinct race win unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not stack. Enter races from the map markers and win one at each distinct race event. Use a tuned vehicle for street races and save off-road events for a suitable vehicle. Your 20th distinct race win unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.inShort: Beat Cal head-to-head in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Unlock fishing through the story, then accept a fishing challenge against Cal.
Use the best bait you own and play the reeling prompts cleanly to protect your catch weight.
Finish the challenge ahead of Cal and the trophy unlocks at the results screen.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal head-to-head in a fishing challenge. Unlock fishing through the story, then accept a fishing challenge against Cal. Use the best bait you own and play the reeling prompts cleanly to protect your catch weight. Finish the challenge ahead of Cal and the trophy unlocks at the results screen.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.inShort: Play one arcade cabinet through to completion.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in free roam and start a game.
Play that same game through to its completion screen rather than quitting mid-run.
The trophy unlocks when the arcade game is marked complete.

trophies.guide: Play one arcade cabinet through to completion. Find an arcade cabinet in free roam and start a game. Play that same game through to its completion screen rather than quitting mid-run. The trophy unlocks when the arcade game is marked complete.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.inShort: Finish Andy's stranger strand, including his final mission.

steps.text: Meet Andy at his stranger marker and complete each mission in his strand as it unlocks.
Return after story progress if his next mission has not appeared yet.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand, including his final mission. Meet Andy at his stranger marker and complete each mission in his strand as it unlocks. Return after story progress if his next mission has not appeared yet. Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.inShort: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, including his final mission.

steps.text: Meet Kenton at his stranger marker and work through his strand in order.
Advance the story between his missions if the next one stays locked.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, including his final mission. Meet Kenton at his stranger marker and work through his strand in order. Advance the story between his missions if the next one stays locked. Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.inShort: Finish Billy's stranger strand, including his final mission.

steps.text: Meet Billy at his stranger marker and complete his missions as they appear.
Check back after major story beats if his strand pauses.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, including his final mission. Meet Billy at his stranger marker and complete his missions as they appear. Check back after major story beats if his strand pauses. Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.inShort: Fully complete 8 different stranger mission strands.

steps.text: Track strands, not single missions: a strand only counts when its final mission is done.
The Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone strands are five of the eight you need.
Finish three more strands found across Leonida; the eighth completion unlocks the Silver.

trophies.guide: Fully complete 8 different stranger mission strands. Track strands, not single missions: a strand only counts when its final mission is done. The Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone strands are five of the eight you need. Finish three more strands found across Leonida; the eighth completion unlocks the Silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.inShort: Finish Randy's stranger strand, including his final mission.

steps.text: Meet Randy at his stranger marker and clear his missions in order.
Let in-game days pass or advance the story if his next mission is delayed.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, including his final mission. Meet Randy at his stranger marker and clear his missions in order. Let in-game days pass or advance the story if his next mission is delayed. Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.inShort: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, including his final mission.

steps.text: Meet Tyrone at his stranger marker and work through his strand.
Return after story progress whenever his next step has not spawned.
Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, including his final mission. Meet Tyrone at his stranger marker and work through his strand. Return after story progress whenever his next step has not spawned. Complete his final mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: One spot is the Chapter 1 balcony. Sources disagree on whether it can be revisited later, so do it during Chapter 1.
trophies.inShort: Meditate at all 18 spots, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony spot.

steps.text: During Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot the story puts in front of you before the chapter ends.
After Chapter 1, work region by region through the remaining meditation spots across Leonida.
Use the in-game count after each spot; a spot only counts once the meditation completes.
The 18th completed meditation unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony spot. During Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot the story puts in front of you before the chapter ends. After Chapter 1, work region by region through the remaining meditation spots across Leonida. Use the in-game count after each spot; a spot only counts once the meditation completes. The 18th completed meditation unlocks the trophy.

a.text: The balcony spot is a one-time story set-piece, but the meditation can be repeated later at an equivalent spot, so nothing is truly missable.

b.text: The balcony meditation is the only missable collectible in the game: skip it in Chapter 1 and the count can never reach 18.

dispute.call: Do the balcony meditation while Chapter 1 is still running. It costs two minutes and removes the only real risk on this trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.inShort: Complete Bret's hunt for the unique animal.

steps.text: Meet Bret and accept his hunting request when his marker appears.
Track the unique animal using the clues the hunt gives you rather than roaming at random.
Bring the hunt back to Bret and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunt for the unique animal. Meet Bret and accept his hunting request when his marker appears. Track the unique animal using the clues the hunt gives you rather than roaming at random. Bring the hunt back to Bret and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.inShort: Finish any 3 full Collectible Card sets.

steps.text: Pick three card sets and collect every card in those sets first instead of spreading effort thin.
Sweep cards while travelling for other trophies and tick them off set by set.
Completing the third full set unlocks the Silver.

trophies.guide: Finish any 3 full Collectible Card sets. Pick three card sets and collect every card in those sets first instead of spreading effort thin. Sweep cards while travelling for other trophies and tick them off set by set. Completing the third full set unlocks the Silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.inShort: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations.

steps.text: Use the WAiNK It interaction once at each new location you pass during other grinds.
Keep the counter honest: revisiting the same location does not add progress.
The 100th distinct location unlocks the Silver.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Use the WAiNK It interaction once at each new location you pass during other grinds. Keep the counter honest: revisiting the same location does not add progress. The 100th distinct location unlocks the Silver.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.inShort: Complete any 50 Challenges from the challenges list.

steps.text: Open the challenges list and clear the short combat, driving and exploration challenges first.
Let long challenges progress in the background while you work on races and stunts.
Your 50th completed challenge unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 Challenges from the challenges list. Open the challenges list and clear the short combat, driving and exploration challenges first. Let long challenges progress in the background while you work on races and stunts. Your 50th completed challenge unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present; easiest while partner free-roam is guaranteed by the story rather than late-game schedules.
trophies.inShort: With your partner beside you, raise 4 stars, then lose them and escape.

steps.text: Pick up your partner so you are travelling together before starting anything.
Commit crimes in view of police until the wanted level reaches exactly 4 stars.
Break line of sight, hide until the stars clear, and the trophy unlocks once you escape the heat together.

trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise 4 stars, then lose them and escape. Pick up your partner so you are travelling together before starting anything. Commit crimes in view of police until the wanted level reaches exactly 4 stars. Break line of sight, hide until the stars clear, and the trophy unlocks once you escape the heat together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: The chain breaks if the wanted level drops between shops, so pick three shops close together and keep moving.
trophies.inShort: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive throughout.

steps.text: Travel with your partner to a cluster of three shops that sit close together.
Rob the first shop, keep the wanted level active, and drive straight to the second.
Rob the third shop without the wanted level ever clearing and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive throughout. Travel with your partner to a cluster of three shops that sit close together. Rob the first shop, keep the wanted level active, and drive straight to the second. Rob the third shop without the wanted level ever clearing and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.inShort: Get in and discover 100 different vehicles.

steps.text: Enter every new vehicle model you see parked or in traffic; discovery registers on entry.
Sweep parking lots, docks and rich districts where rarer models spawn.
The 100th distinct vehicle discovered unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Get in and discover 100 different vehicles. Enter every new vehicle model you see parked or in traffic; discovery registers on entry. Sweep parking lots, docks and rich districts where rarer models spawn. The 100th distinct vehicle discovered unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.inShort: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation.

steps.text: Find a spot where at least five enemies group together, such as a gang operation.
Weaken the group if needed, then trigger Combat Focus and chain headshots quickly.
Five takedowns inside the single activation unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Find a spot where at least five enemies group together, such as a gang operation. Weaken the group if needed, then trigger Combat Focus and chain headshots quickly. Five takedowns inside the single activation unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to VCIA access around the VCIA Takedown window; sources disagree on late-game airport access, so do it early.
trophies.inShort: At VCIA airport, depart in a way the schedule never planned.

steps.text: Head to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) in free roam while access is open.
Take an aircraft out of the airport without following a scheduled departure.
Once you are airborne on the unscheduled departure, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, depart in a way the schedule never planned. Head to VCIA in free roam while access is open. Take an aircraft out of the airport without following a scheduled departure. Once you are airborne on the unscheduled departure, the trophy unlocks.

a.text: VCIA can be re-entered freely all game, so this can be done at any point, including post-story.

b.text: After VCIA Takedown the airport locks down and the departure window closes, making this missable.

dispute.call: Do it before or during the VCIA Takedown window. Early is free; late might be impossible.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Hidden with a joke description; the exact Rhino trigger is unconfirmed, so treat any tank encounter as your chance.
trophies.inShort: Get into trouble involving a Rhino tank. Exact trigger unconfirmed - see notes.

steps.text: Raise a maximum wanted level or visit a military response until a Rhino tank is deployed.
Engage with the Rhino at close range; unconfirmed reports tie the unlock to surviving or entering one.
If it does not pop, retry at the next tank encounter and note what you did; this trigger is still unconfirmed across sources.

trophies.guide: Get into trouble involving a Rhino tank. The exact trigger is unconfirmed across sources, so this guide stays honest: raise a maximum wanted level until a Rhino is deployed, engage with it at close range, and if the trophy does not pop, retry at the next tank encounter and note what you did differently.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Detection voids the attempt, not the trophy; you can retry, but enter masked and quiet or the run is wasted.
trophies.inShort: Clean out a jewelry store with zero detection.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store, wear a mask, and enter with a suppressed or melee approach.
Control the room quietly, loot the cases, and avoid triggering any alarm or witness call.
Leave undetected and the trophy unlocks once the robbery completes clean.

trophies.guide: Clean out a jewelry store with zero detection. Pick a jewelry store, wear a mask, and enter with a suppressed or melee approach. Control the room quietly, loot the cases, and avoid triggering any alarm or witness call. Leave undetected and the trophy unlocks once the robbery completes clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.inShort: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly each time.

steps.text: Case a bank, enter the vault, and take the cash during a vault robbery opportunity.
Escape and fully lose the wanted level; a vault only counts once you get away.
Repeat at five vaults in total and the Silver unlocks on the fifth escape.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly each time. Case a bank, enter the vault, and take the cash during a vault robbery opportunity. Escape and fully lose the wanted level; a vault only counts once you get away. Repeat at five vaults in total and the Silver unlocks on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.inShort: Hit one armored truck and get away with it.

steps.text: Watch for an armored truck on its route and block it in with your vehicle.
Breach the rear doors, grab the cash, and leave before the response escalates.
Lose the wanted level completely and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Hit one armored truck and get away with it. Watch for an armored truck on its route and block it in with your vehicle. Breach the rear doors, grab the cash, and leave before the response escalates. Lose the wanted level completely and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.inShort: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is explored.

steps.text: Open the map and sweep the greyed-out areas region by region.
Drive the coastline and the Keys last; small island areas are the easiest to leave behind.
Entering the 52nd and final area unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is explored. Open the map and sweep the greyed-out areas region by region. Drive the coastline and the Keys last; small island areas are the easiest to leave behind. Entering the 52nd and final area unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.inShort: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.

steps.text: Identify which gang owns an operation before you hit it, and log the gang in your notes.
Rob the operation and escape; one robbery per gang is enough.
Robbing the ninth gang's operation unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Identify which gang owns an operation before you hit it, and log the gang in your notes. Rob the operation and escape; one robbery per gang is enough. Robbing the ninth gang's operation unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.inShort: Have a cocktail at Ocean Beach with the view the description hints at.

steps.text: Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam, ideally in the early game when you first reach the coast.
Order a cocktail at the beachfront spot overlooking the ocean.
Finish the drink interaction and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at Ocean Beach with the view the description hints at. Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam, ideally in the early game when you first reach the coast. Order a cocktail at the beachfront spot overlooking the ocean. Finish the drink interaction and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.inShort: Steal a showroom car by driving it straight through the glass.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom on foot and get into a display car.
Accelerate straight out through the showroom glass instead of using the door.
Once you are out on the street in the car, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Steal a showroom car by driving it straight through the glass. Enter a vehicle showroom on foot and get into a display car. Accelerate straight out through the showroom glass instead of using the door. Once you are out on the street in the car, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.inShort: Bowl a follow-through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley.

steps.text: Visit the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and start a game of bowling.
Bowl your frames and complete the follow-through interaction the alley prompts.
Finish the game and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Bowl a follow-through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. Visit the alley and start a game of bowling. Bowl your frames and complete the follow-through interaction the alley prompts. Finish the game and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Hidden with a deliberately vague description; the partner-activity trigger is unconfirmed, so log partner sessions as you go.
trophies.inShort: A partner moment with mass appeal. Trigger unconfirmed - log partner activities.

steps.text: Spend free-roam time with your partner and complete partner activities together.
Unconfirmed reports link this to a public partner activity drawing a crowd reaction.
Keep trying partner activities in busy public spots; note the exact activity if it pops.

trophies.guide: A partner moment with mass appeal. The trigger is unconfirmed across sources, so this guide stays honest: spend free-roam time with your partner, complete partner activities in busy public spots, and note the exact activity in your notes if it pops.

a.text: It unlocks from a partner activity performed in front of a crowd, a mass appeal moment.

b.text: It is a story-adjacent partner scene that unlocks automatically and cannot be chased in free roam.

dispute.call: Try public partner activities first; if none pop it, progress the story and watch for it there.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Counted to 500 per the starter hint; whether every choice type counts is unconfirmed, so make choices whenever offered.
trophies.inShort: Make choices whenever the game offers them; the counter runs to 500.

steps.text: Never skip a dialogue or story choice prompt; pick an option every time one appears.
Side activities with branching outcomes also feed the count, so vary your approach.
At 500 recorded choices the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Make choices whenever the game offers them; the counter runs to 500. Never skip a dialogue or story choice prompt; pick an option every time one appears. Side activities with branching outcomes also feed the count, so vary your approach. At 500 recorded choices the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Hidden joke description; failing once then succeeding is the working theory and is unconfirmed.
trophies.inShort: Fail something, then succeed at it on the second try. Unconfirmed trigger.

steps.text: Pick a repeatable activity such as a race or challenge and fail it once on purpose.
Immediately retry the same activity and succeed on the second attempt.
If it does not pop, try the fail-then-succeed pattern on a different activity; the trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed at it on the second try. The trigger is unconfirmed, so this guide stays honest: pick a repeatable activity, fail it once, immediately retry and succeed, and if it does not pop, try the same pattern on a different activity.

a.text: Any fail-then-succeed on a repeatable activity unlocks it.

b.text: It is tied to one specific activity failing once, not a general pattern.

dispute.call: Start with races, the cheapest fail-retry loop, then widen to challenges if needed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strange-event trophy with no confirmed location; explore odd spots at night and log anything unusual.
trophies.inShort: Witness a strange event somewhere in Leonida. Location unconfirmed.

steps.text: Explore remote and swamp areas at night, where strange events are reported.
Stay and watch any unusual event through to its end instead of driving away.
Witnessing the event fully unlocks the trophy; log where it happened in your notes.

trophies.guide: Witness a strange event somewhere in Leonida. The location is unconfirmed across sources, so this guide stays honest: explore remote and swamp areas at night, stay and watch any unusual event through to its end, and log where it happened in your notes.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.inShort: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle.

steps.text: Drive slowly past a group of pedestrians with a melee weapon equipped as driver.
Swing the melee drive-by so the hit connects with a pedestrian as you pass.
A clean knockdown from the moving vehicle unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a group of pedestrians with a melee weapon equipped as driver. Swing the melee drive-by so the hit connects as you pass. A clean knockdown from the moving vehicle unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.inShort: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and hold them instead of spending them raw.
Pass the bills to your laundering contacts whenever a batch is ready.
Keep the counter running across sessions; $250,000 laundered in total unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from robberies and hold them instead of spending them raw. Pass the bills to your laundering contacts whenever a batch is ready. Keep the counter running across sessions; $250,000 laundered in total unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.inShort: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops of any kind.

steps.text: Buy vehicles, weapons, clothes and upgrades normally; every shop purchase counts.
Save big purchases such as garage stock and top-end vehicles for this grind.
Crossing $100,000 total shop spending unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops of any kind. Buy vehicles, weapons, clothes and upgrades normally; every shop purchase counts. Save big purchases such as garage stock and top-end vehicles for this grind. Crossing $100,000 total shop spending unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.inShort: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map.

steps.text: Earn money through heists, robberies and laundering until garages are affordable.
Buy each garage property from its for-sale sign as you unlock new districts.
Purchasing the eighth and final garage unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map. Earn money through heists, robberies and laundering until garages are affordable. Buy each garage property from its for-sale sign as you unlock new districts. Purchasing the eighth and final garage unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.inShort: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone when you acquire a vehicle you keep.
Register the vehicle to the app before selling or losing it.
The tenth registered vehicle unlocks the trophy.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone when you acquire a vehicle you keep. Register the vehicle to the app before selling or losing it. The tenth registered vehicle unlocks the trophy.
